subject: Mutual evaluation plan & pricing — approval path for Novus commercial ask
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@novusanalytics.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Novus evaluation MAP & commercial ask

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Tom and I are aligned that Redwood checks the technical boxes. Procurement asked me to put our proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and commercial asks in writing so they can move the review faster. Attached is Novus-MAP-v2.xlsx with milestone dates. High level: we want a 120-day evaluation with three gate milestones (POC success, stakeholder validation, production pilot).

Commercial ask: during the evaluation and initial ramp (first 3 months post-pilot) we are requesting a temporary evaluation discount across generation and embed calls. Procurement is also seeking a two-step commitment discount if we hit the agreed ramp profile (commit to 200K API units/month after pilot). The procurement team will need visible internal approvals for any discount >=15%. Can you confirm Redwood's approval path and an expected close timeline?

Procurement deadlines: they aim to have terms signed and PO issued by Aug 7 to hit Q3 budget cycles. Would Redwood be able to align?

Attachments: Novus-MAP-v2.xlsx

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of Product Strategy
Novus Analytics
[attachment: Novus-MAP-v2.xlsx]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@novusanalytics.com>
Cc: Tom Weiss <tom.weiss@novusanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-07-10T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novus evaluation MAP & commercial ask

Hi Elena — really appreciate the clear MAP. Glad Tom found the demo useful.

We can support a 120-day evaluation with the three gates you described. Attached is a pricing proposal that maps to the milestones and includes two discount levers: a temporary evaluation discount during the POC (pilot-rate) and a committed discount tied to a revenue/volume ramp after pilot. For internal governance, anything up to 15% is within my approval. Anything above that will require VP/CFO review. I’ve highlighted the following proposal:

- Evaluation (up to 120 days): 20% off list for all API usage during the POC period
- Commit (12-month initial term at agreed ramp): 12% off list once the monthly commit of 200K units is met for two consecutive months
- Conditions: Net30 payment terms, non-refundable ramp onboarding fee to cover priority support during pilot

I’m attaching the proposal (redwood-pricing-proposal.pdf) and will loop in my leadership for any ask above 15%. Can you confirm the milestone dates in Novus-MAP-v2 and whether the PO timeline Aug 7 is firm? If so, I’ll start the approval chain internally today.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-pricing-proposal.pdf]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-11T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Novus evaluation MAP & commercial ask — request for pricing exception

Team — forwarding Novus' MAP and procurement timeline. Novus is a strategic analytics platform (large reference potential) and wants to close terms by Aug 7 to hit their Q3 cycle. Current ask from Aditya (below): evaluation discount 20% during POC, commit discount 12% on a $300K+ 12-month commitment after ramp.

I’m requesting an exception to allow up to 25% pilot discount (one-time evaluation concession) and 15% on initial commit to secure the deal now. Rationale:
- Probability of expansion high given cross-sell signals from their Data Science org
- Reference and case study potential for our enterprise vertical plays
- Short timeline (PO by Aug 7) — we either accelerate or risk losing Q3 close

Attachments: Novus-MAP-v2.xlsx, SOW-draft.docx (first pass) and the pricing PDF.

Please reply with approval level or counteroffer. If we need to escalate to CFO/CEO for >20% concession I’ll route accordingly.

Thanks,
Aditya
[attachment: SOW-draft.docx]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Novus evaluation MAP & commercial ask — request for pricing exception

Aditya — thanks for the context and the write-up. I’m comfortable approving discounts up to 20% for the evaluation period given the strategic upside and the aggressive close date. For the committed discount, I can approve up to 12% contingent on signed ramp commitments (minimum 12-month term and evidence of billing to match the ramp within 60 days post-pilot).

If you’re asking for 25% evaluation or >15% committed discounts, that needs Vivek’s signoff. Also require:
- A non-refundable onboarding fee (to offset discounted pilot costs)
- A clause tying the discount step-down if commit thresholds are not met

Loop Marcus in for implementation/CS readiness to ensure we can meet the priority support terms in the SOW.

Laura Bennett
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T16:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Novus evaluation MAP & commercial ask — final approval and conditions

Thanks all — reviewed the rationale. I will approve a final commercial path with the following conditions:

- Evaluation discount: 22% (one-time concession during POC; capped to evaluation period only)
- Commit discount: 12% on a 12-month minimum contract after confirmed ramp (200K units/month sustained for two consecutive months)
- Revenue threshold: minimum committed ARR of $300,000 within the 12-month term
- Payment terms: Net30, with first invoice due upon contract signature (no extended pilot-only deferred billing)
- Onboarding fee: a non-refundable $10,000 to secure priority support during pilot
- Verification: usage and billing verification to be provided by our billing team; discount will be retroactively adjusted if commit thresholds are not matched

Please ensure the legal and procurement teams get the SOW and pricing attachments (SOW-draft.docx + redwood-pricing-proposal.pdf). If Novus asks for any further concession >22%, escalate to the CEO for final approval.

Vivek Kulkarni
CFO, Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-pricing-proposal.pdf]
